name: Structural Utilization v136
oracle_policy: true law/labels only for final audit; learned utilization mode updated from observed prediction outcomes, not hidden law identity

policies.apply_T_again: apply identified T to observed state again
policies.apply_inverse: apply approximate inverse of identified T before scoring
policies.learned_utilization: learn per-law utilization mode from prior episodes, then apply mode to future episodes
policies.use_observed: after identifying T, predict from observed state directly
